children: DNA sequencing tech firm's fiscal Q3 revenue rose 4% yr/yr but missed analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for fiscal Q3 beat analyst expectations
Company raised full-year revenue and earnings guidance, citing clinical demand and NovaSeq X placements
Illumina raises 2026 revenue guidance to $4.64-$4.66 bln, up from $4.60-$4.64 bln
Company now sees 2026 non-GAAP diluted EPS at $5.40-$5.45, up from $5.30-$5.40
Illumina maintains 2026 organic revenue growth outlook above 4% and ROW organic growth above 5%
CLINICAL DEMAND - Co said healthy clinical demand contributed to Q3 results
NOVASEQ X PLACEMENTS - Robust NovaSeq X placements supported Q3 performance, per CEO Jacob Thaysen
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 10 "strong buy" or "buy", 9 "hold" and 3 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the advanced medical equipment & technology peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Illumina Inc is $272.50, about 5.6% below its October 28 closing price of $288.79
The stock recently traded at 48 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 32 three months ago
